| description = Named mob from the Pickclaw invasion of RunnyEye. Moldmaster is a repugnant half-man, half mushroom hybrid with fruiting spores for a eyes. He can spawn (presumably) anywhere in the Sporali area. He has been seen as far in as the northern lake and as close to the entrance as the first sporali spawn on the ramp from Level 1 to 3. The Moldmaster is a very tough fight, as he has access to powerful druid spells. The AC Debuff, DoT, Thorns and his own regeneration, and heals make it a deadly task for level appropriate melee hunting for upgrades. On top of that, he has a unique slow called Mort Drowsy. Very aggressive mob. The Sporestrand Shield is extremely common, dropping almost 100% of the time
Upon Death: spawns 3x [[a sporeling]]
